answer_1.quote: Dialogue State Tracking (DST) refers to the task of estimating and tracking the dialogue state consisting of the user's current intent and set of slot-value pairs throughout the dialogue.
answer_1.outputs: slot values, intent predictions, and dialogue state updates

answer_2.quote: we evaluate our approach according to the following two metrics. Intent Accuracy: For intent detection the intent accuracy describes the fraction of turns for which the active intent has been correctly inferred. Joint Goal Accuracy (JGA): For slot prediction JGA describes the fraction of turns for which all slot values have been predicted correctly.
